title: Evolution of the cardiac function during the follow-up of the anticancer immunotherapy inhibiting PD-1
official:
Evolution of the cardiac function during the follow-up of the anticancer immunotherapy inhibiting PD-1.
IMMUNOCARD
summary: Main objective: To describe the evolution of left ventricular function in patients treated with nivolumab or pembrolizumab based on recommended monitoring data in a Cardio-Oncology unit.
criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
1. All patients selected to receive treatment with nivolumab or pembrolizumab in participating departments.
2. patients affiliated to a national insurance scheme
Exclusion criteria:
1. Age < 18 years
2. Poor echogenicity, not amenable to echocardiography
3. general condition not amenable to cardiac MRI.
4. Pre-existing heart disease with FeVG <50
5. Dilated, hypertrophic or restrictive cardiomyopathy
6. History of cardiac arrhythmia
7. History of cardiac toxicity on other anti-cancer treatments
8. Known coronary artery disease
9. History of stroke less than 3 months old
10. Patient not wishing to participate in the study
11. Vulnerable persons (pregnant women, adults under guardianship, persons deprived of liberty)

sites.f: Centre Hospitalier Regional De Marseille – Cardiologie
